moments.name: It reads at your pauses
moments.caption: It reads each paragraph when you pause.

moments.name: A thread from your words
moments.caption: When a line doesn’t add up, it pulls a thread from those words.

moments.name: It shows its working
moments.caption: It shows its working, from your own numbers.

moments.name: Fix the words
moments.caption: Fix the words, and the thread ties itself off.

moments.name: Select words, and it asks
moments.caption: Select any words, and it finds the question in them.

moments.name: Write back, and tie it off
moments.caption: Write back. When it’s settled, tie it off.

moments.name: The thinking stays yours
moments.caption: It never writes your notes. The thinking stays yours.
